proof_body:
by
  intro a σ h
  have h₁ : Summable a := h.of_abs
  have h₂ : Summable (fun n => a (σ n)) := σ.summable_iff.2 h₁
  have h₃ : (∑' n, a (σ n)) = ∑' n, a n := σ.tsum_eq a
  rw [← h₃]
  exact h₂.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ℕ), Summable (fun n => |a n|) → Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a (σ n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' n, a n))
